scope: V7 G1 protocol freeze; no formal multi-seed execution

historical_reference.warning: e600 first 200 epochs are not e200 evidence; the cosine horizon changes the LR trajectory

proposed_budget.lr_trajectory_definition: warmup through epoch 10, cosine decay from base_lr to min_lr through epoch 200

insufficient_if: best checkpoint remains concentrated at epochs 195-200 with clear validation improvement at the boundary
validation primary/selection metric is still clearly monotonic improving through the final window
Vanilla RIGNO has not received a fair converged opportunity
decision_rule.if_insufficient: qualify_e300_only; do not default back to e600
pass_requires: Full and Vanilla both have stable late validation behavior
no clear undertraining signal in either route
LR reaches the registered minimum at the selected horizon
train/valid behavior and gradient/loss diagnostics remain finite and stable
